sources_consumed.used_at: decoupled BL determinant expansion, uniform Fourier Lp lemma, and D' at h=2/3
fixed-three-anchor packet receiver for bounded column-tail core

new_results.statement: For selected physical degree-3 and degree-2 determinant packets with masses Z3,Z2, a disjoint coupling of reweighted column subset laws with KL costs D3,D2 yields ||p_Q||inf <= 5*2^(4/5)*sqrt(e)*exp((D3+D2)/10)*(Z3 Z2)^(-1/10), retaining arbitrary self blocks and affine terms. Independent canonical disjoint probability delta gives factor delta^(-1/10).

For fixed anchor rows u,v with Z2=det(KK^T), projection P onto their row plane and residual rows r_i=(I-P)w_i, anchored third volume Gamma equals Z2 sum_i||r_i||^2; its column marginal beta_j equals anchor-plane leverage ell_j=P_jj plus residual energy share c_j.
If max anchor-plane leverage ell_*<=1/4, canonical E2 and anchored E3 packets are disjoint with probability >=1/4, hence ||p_Q||inf <16.488 (Gamma Z2)^(-1/10).
If a physical column support C of size m has anchored marginal tail delta_C<1, then ||p_Q||inf <=3sqrt(2)[C(m,3)/((1-delta_C)Gamma)]^(1/6); at m=8, delta_C<=1/2 the constant is <9.315 Gamma^(-1/6).

required_source_application: If max anchored third-volume column marginal beta_j<=2/3, pinned D' gives ||p_Q||inf<=9sqrt(3e) Gamma^(-1/6)<25.702 Gamma^(-1/6).
partner_application: On account03/B07 r29 aggregate branch Z2>=H^4/4096 with H=1.1533650070389015e-6; under max anchor-plane leverage<=1/4 the new theorem gives ||p_Q||inf<7408.219 Gamma^(-1/10). Partner common-bank rank-one tube remains separate.
structural_stress: The exact bipartite target family with cross rows e1,e2 and one flat unit row on m new columns has spectrum +/-1 each multiplicity 3, Z2=Gamma=1, anchor leverages ell1=ell2=1, anchored marginals beta1=beta2=1, and no bounded-cardinality principal block with a fixed third spectral scale. It refutes only a bounded-core extraction shortcut, not QFORM.
first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-TWOANCHOR-HIGHLEV-ONECOLOOP-MIXEDHUB-v1: after all new exits fail, retain a physical anchor-plane leverage >1/4, a physical column in >2/3 of anchored third-volume mass, and a genuinely diffuse residual determinant tail; pay this by a mixed-hub/grouped-coordinate estimate with arbitrary same-bank curvature and extra spectrum.
